notes:
Task (the commit message of the change being reviewed): Share one gh wrapper and one paths module across the harness scripts

review-wait, revert-check, rules-propose, ticket-ready, factory-tick and
verdict each spawned gh with their own time limit and buffer; factory-tick
and rules-propose also computed the private directory without honouring
FAULTFORGE_PRIVATE_DIR. Both now come from packages/harness/src/github.ts
and paths.ts, so every script agrees on where things are and how long a
call waits. Argument parsing across the scripts that take options now
goes through node:util's parseArgs instead of five different hand-rolled
styles.
